::: {.partner-note}
**A partner-led study.** This project was proposed by an African research team. CognosX leads the research mapping and analysis; the team uses the results to find research gaps and support grant applications. Part of the [Research in Africa](research-in-africa.qmd) programme.
:::

## The question

Ticks spread diseases to people and animals, and climate change is moving them to new places. This study looks at the world's research on ticks: what is known, which topics are growing or fading, who produces and leads the research, and whether African researchers lead the work on problems that affect Africa.

**How:** a science-of-science study of tick research from seven bibliographic sources, with a systematic review (PRISMA 2020) alongside it. Records were screened with AI and then checked by hand.
